Resolves #21779

The five departure polls in `Departure.spec.mjs` now share `departurePoll = {timeout: 500, intervals: [10, 20, 50]}` instead of `{timeout: 150}` with the default 100ms first sleep. Line 83 keeps its message. Test only.

Evidence: L2 (spec repeated locally) -> L2 required.

|---|---|
| AC-1 | All five polls (lines 83, 120, 145, 417, 460) use `departurePoll` |
| AC-2 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/tooltip/Departure.spec.mjs --repeat-each=20`: 400 passed, 0 flaky. `check-fixed-sleeps.mjs`: OK |
